trainer/30113.htm.text: Magister Juris: May your spirit be as peaceful as the waters of a calm lake. It is always nice to meet a fellow Elf in this strange land. To see the people here, you would never think they had known anything else but peace and prosperity. But in fact there is a hidden Dark Shadow here. Perhaps you …

trainer/30113-1.htm.text: Magister Juris: Very well. The cause of that shadow is Land Dragon Antharas, the legendary Earth Dragon born of Shilen. It sleeps in the recesses of the Valley of Dragons, but who can say when it will awaken? If that happens, all this prosperity will dissolve into fear and chaos in an instant.

links.text: Ask about the Valley of Dragons.

trainer/30113-2.htm.text: Magister Juris: It is an enormous canyon located to the north of this village. Long ago, many drakes and dragons resided there. Even now, many careless hunters perish there. Many monsters summoned by Land Dragon Antharas still inhabit the canyon and protect its nest. If you're thinking about visiti…

trainer/30113-noteach.htm.text: Magister Juris: May the tranquility of the still lakes be with you. I am Magister Juris and I teach magic to the Elves. I would like to share my knowledge with you, but unfortunately only Elven Mystics can understand my teachings. I'm sure there is someone who can teach you, if you search further.

Q00190_LostDream/30113-01.html.text: Magister Juris: How can I help you?

links.text: "I came to learn where the last Cruma is located."

Q00190_LostDream/30113-04.html.text: Magister Juris: I already told you of the Cruma's fate. Your journey to find one is in vain. I am sorry...

Q00190_LostDream/30113-02.html.text: Magister Juris: Cruma... Where did you learn that name?

links.text: "It was contained in an old record of the Giants recovered from the Tower of Cruma."

Q00190_LostDream/30113-03.html.text: Magister Juris: Ah, I see. Well, I am afraid I must disappoint you. The Cruma are entirely extinct. Do you know of the ancient war between the Elves and Humans? No? At that time, the last Cruma became our greatest ally. Despite its massive size and strength, though, we were overwhelmed by sheer num…

links.text: Ask about the Agathion in charge of skill enchantment.

common/skill_enchant_help_01.htm.text: Skill Enchanting allows you to strengthen certain skills that have reached their maximum level. You must be level 76 or above and have completed your 3rd class transfer in order to take advantage of this system. To enchant your skills, simply speak to Agathion Pona. To do this, open your skills win…

common/skill_enchant_help_02.htm.text: Back in the day, Skill Enchanting was a tedious process that could only be done through specific people throughout the land. But those days are gone. Now all you have to do is open your skill window and click on the Skill Enchanting button at the bottom. How easy is that!

common/skill_enchant_help_03.htm.text: There are several Skill Enchanting options at your disposal: General Skill Enchant, Blessed Skill Enchant, Skill Un-Enchanting and Skill Route Change.
